scope: Cross-ledger semantic change history and idempotency for Fortnite France/Europe
purpose: Persist causal material changes with stable subject revisions so replays converge to the same change while genuine repeated lifecycle transitions remain distinguishable.

delivery_boundary.rule: This ledger records what changed. Notification reservation/delivery state is canonical only in fortnite-notification-outbox-france.json.
delivery_boundary.important_limit: Exactly-once presentation in an external client UI cannot be proven by the repository; RESERVED is therefore treated conservatively as consumed.

bootstrap.policy: All semantic state already present in this manifest is known history. A restart, parser rewrite or rediscovery of these facts must not create a new change or notification.

causal_identity.problem_solved: A pure before/after fingerprint would incorrectly suppress a legitimate repeated transition such as SOLD_OUT -> AVAILABLE -> SOLD_OUT. V2 chains each occurrence to the previous accepted change for the same subject/scope.
causal_identity.subject_revision: Monotonic integer per subject_scope_key. Revision increments only for an accepted material semantic transition.
causal_identity.causal_parent_change_id: Previous accepted change_id for the same subject_scope_key, or null for the first post-bootstrap change.
causal_identity.state_fingerprint: SHA256 canonical JSON of the material canonical state after the change.
causal_identity.transition_fingerprint: SHA256 canonical JSON of change_type + material_before + material_after + material_evidence_state.
causal_identity.replay_rule: Reprocessing the same transition against the same causal parent must reproduce the same revision/change_id and therefore no-op.
causal_identity.real_recurrence_rule: If the same before/after transition genuinely recurs later, its causal parent/revision differs, so it receives a distinct change_id and may notify once again.

rules: sort set-like arrays by stable ID/value
preserve ordered arrays only when order has business meaning
normalize equivalent timezone-aware instants to RFC3339 UTC for hashing while retaining source timezone in domain ledgers
normalize URLs by removing non-identity tracking parameters only
distinguish null from UNKNOWN when domain semantics require it
normalize localized titles/aliases out of identity when a stable ID exists

change_acceptance.fresh_canonical_read: Before accepting a change, read the latest canonical domain state and the latest subject head/index. A Git SHA difference alone is never enough.
change_acceptance.out_of_order_guard: Older/stale source data cannot move the canonical subject backward unless it is an explicit official correction or genuine later transition.
change_acceptance.evidence_upgrade: Evidence-only changes are material only if authority/confidence/finality/territory changes the supported business meaning or resolves a prior ambiguity.
change_acceptance.policy_freeze: notification_disposition is recorded when the change is accepted. A later notification policy update does not retroactively alert old SILENT_POLICY/BASELINE changes unless explicitly requested as a manual replay.

notification_linkage.notification_key: Derived from sorted change_ids + notice_kind + audience_key + channel_key. It intentionally uses change occurrence identity, not only state fingerprints.
notification_linkage.coalescing: Related changes may share one notification intent, but each change remains individually auditable.
notification_linkage.planned_boundary: Future reminders are not notification intents until due. ELIGIBLE_WHEN_DUE remains in the domain reminder ledger/change disposition until its trigger time and conditions are revalidated.
notification_linkage.payload_freeze: Payload wording/version never changes notification identity after reservation.

repository_write_idempotency.cas_rule: Use fresh blob SHA for every write. On conflict, discard stale mutation, re-fetch and recompute. Never retry a stale full-file payload.
repository_write_idempotency.unknown_commit_state: Fresh-fetch target and compare desired semantic fingerprint. If already present, record recovery and skip duplicate commit.
repository_write_idempotency.sequence_rule: ICS SEQUENCE changes only when projected business state changes, never for headers, folding, DTSTAMP refresh or change-index maintenance.

audit_and_reconciliation.subject_heads: Derived in fortnite-change-index-france.json; rebuild from changes if divergent.
audit_and_reconciliation.orphan_change: A change whose domain target no longer resolves is retained for audit and flagged for reconciliation, not deleted.
audit_and_reconciliation.outbox_reconciliation: Every outbox intent must reference existing change_ids. Every consumed key must be derivable from outbox delivery events.
audit_and_reconciliation.calendar_reconciliation: A CALENDAR_PROJECTION change may reference the source domain change_ids that caused it to prevent duplicate user alerts for the same underlying fact.

retention.changes: Append-only in the active ledger until archive policy is introduced.
retention.notification_keys: Permanent dedupe tombstones live in the outbox or future archive and must be queryable before reservation.
retention.archives: Future archives must preserve change_id, subject revision chain, consumed notification keys and hash/checkpoint metadata.
retention.no_time_based_forgetting: Never allow a notification duplicate merely because an old receipt/change aged out.

history.note: Existing canonical Fortnite state imported as silent baseline.
Added causal subject revisions, recurrence-safe change identity, policy-freeze semantics, CAS write rules and a separate transactional notification outbox.
